judge.rationale: Roughly half to two-thirds of the molecular content overlaps through GNLY, CCL5, PTPRC isoform biology, and the IGHM/CD79A/TCL1A B-cell subset, while A uniquely emphasizes TRDC, IL2RB, and MS4A1 and B emphasizes GZMB, NKG7, FGFBP2, and IGHD, so the incomplete-coverage ceiling of 6 applies.
